summary: Keep operation-conflict discovery incremental across checkpoint trims, and bound daemon discovery and projection turns instead of queueing receives behind a whole-history scan.

replay.detail: Deleting sources or recording identical live claims as checkpoint tombstones no longer invalidates conflict discovery. Restore insertions and source changes still invalidate. Existing conservative replay fences remain until explicit repair; keyed conflict handling remains active.

schema.detail: Replace the checkpoint-insert trigger and remove deletion invalidation triggers on open. Existing discovery watermarks and generations remain usable. No storage or wire-version change.

rules.detail: Operation conflicts still exclude conflicting graph effects; no trust or admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Peers remain wire-compatible. Explicit repair and offline projection APIs still drain the requested backlog.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond installing the updated daemon.

manual.detail: Deferred daemon turns continue through admission maintenance without another peer exchange.

recovery.detail: Watermarks commit per discovery page. An interrupted turn resumes from durable progress. An older binary can reopen the store and may reinstall conservative deletion invalidation.
